verdicts.title: Karchmer-Wigderson Games for Hazard-free Computation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We present a Karchmer-Wigderson game to study the complexity of hazard-free formulas. This new game is both a generalization of the monotone Karchmer-Wigderson game and an analog of the classical Boolean Karchmer-Wigderson game. Therefore, it acts as a bridge between the existing monotone and general games.

verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses a new Karchmer-Wigderson game variant for hazard-free formulas and proves formula size/depth lower bounds for specific functions like the multiplexer, but makes no claim about VC/dual-VC dimension of the KW conflict family or the specific inequality d(f) >= ceil(log2(dvc(f)+1)).

verdicts.title: Sign rank versus VC dimension
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
This work studies the maximum possible sign rank of $N \times N$ sign matrices with a given VC dimension $d$. For $d=1$, this maximum is {three}. For $d=2$, this maximum is $\tildeΘ(N^{1/2})$. verdicts.title: String Dimension: VC Dimension for Infinite Shattering
